title: The crux: five content buckets and the buyer's questions (research/crux.json)
description: Every fact about the client, sorted into five buckets before any plan or copy is written, and the questions real buyers ask before they buy (They Ask, You Answer). A fact names its source id from research/sources.json, or "assumption". What is not known is a gap, written as a question for the client, and is never filled by inventing.

buyerQuestions.description: The questions buyers ask before they buy, by the They Ask, You Answer Big 5 (pricing, problems, comparisons, reviews, best of) plus edge cases. Each has a source where the business already answers it, or a gap saying what the client must tell us.

source.description: Where the answer comes from: a source id from research/sources.json, or "assumption".

gap.description: What the client must tell us before this can be answered.

gaps.description: What is missing from this bucket, as a question for the client.
